muc.loi_ro: the two of you may easily misunderstand each other's words, especially when you're both tired.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Each week, keep one session just for the two of you, without talking about money or the children.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: Your partner is gentle, capable and caring; this is a big strength of your family.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Set family goals for the next few years together and divide tasks according to each person's strengths.
muc.loi_nguoi_ay: Their chart sketches a gentle, capable, caring partner — a point of support the two of you can keep together.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: Your partner is capable and well liked; their help is a strength of your family.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Acknowledge the work your partner does and let them take the lead on things they're good at.
muc.loi_nguoi_ay: Their chart sketches a capable, well-liked partner; helping each other is the two of you's strength.
muc.viec_nguoi_ay: Acknowledge the work each of you does and let each take the lead on things they're good at.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: One school of thought holds that deciding to marry after coming through a turbulent period lasts better than marrying in the middle of the turbulence.
muc.viec_nen_lam: If you're in an unsettled period, don't rush big decisions; use the time to understand each other better.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: A year full of matters to do with people — family, friends, a partner — is also a year when marriage easily comes up for discussion.
muc.viec_nen_lam: If you're getting to know someone, choose this year to talk seriously about shared plans.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: If your partner has always loved fun and a wide social circle, that rarely changes after marriage.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Agree on clear boundaries with others from the start, rather than hoping your partner will change.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: You and your children may see things differently, especially as they grow up; spoken instructions have little effect.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Ask your child's view before deciding things about them, and keep the small promises you make to them.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: Your children are likely to study or work far away and become independent early.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Prepare your child with independence skills early: cooking, managing money, getting around alone.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: You have a knack with business friends; the people you know are usually well placed and willing to contribute.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Start partnerships in a year when money is going well, and avoid years of drain.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: Partnering with friends can leave you carrying all the work, and pulling out later can damage the friendship; guaranteeing loans for others can easily become your burden.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Don't act as guarantor for loans; if you partner up, draw up a contract with an exit clause.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: You often run errands for friends, putting in a lot of effort and rarely getting it back.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Before agreeing to help, ask how long the task will take and who covers the costs.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: In partnerships, you suit putting in capital or providing expertise while a capable friend runs the day-to-day.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Put each person's voting rights in writing before investing.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: You suit the role of running things, while capital usually comes from well-off friends.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Report on money regularly to those who put in capital, even if they don't ask.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: The old books remind homes with this trait to pay attention to fire and electrical safety.
muc.loi_ro: The old books remind you to pay attention to fire and electrical safety in your home.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Check wiring and the gas stove regularly and keep a fire extinguisher within easy reach.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: Pay attention to the security of belongings at home, especially when you're away for long.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Fit good locks and a door camera, and don't leave valuables in plain sight.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: Your property papers can easily get caught up in disputes; be careful about whose name assets are held in.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Have someone with legal expertise check the paperwork before buying, and think carefully about whose name goes on the title.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: You have a knack with property; the more you build up, the more it grows.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Buy within what you can repay, one asset at a time.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: You suit working and having your own income all your life; long breaks in work can leave you feeling lost.
muc.viec_nen_lam: If you have to stop for a while, keep a small piece of work going so you don't lose the thread of your trade.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: If you study or work far away, you tend to stay and build your life in the new place.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Before moving far, agree with your family on a plan for visits and caring for your parents.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: Later on, your social role and responsibilities are where you put most of your energy.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Keep an interest outside work so you have somewhere to rest when work gets tense.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: You're good at your field but rarely want to command; an adviser or expert role suits you better than managing many people.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Build a professional reputation: write, teach, share experience in your field.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: You have both expertise and the ability to run things; you suit heading a specialist department.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Learn people-management skills to go from expert to manager.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: For people in business, this trait means reputation: your name helps open doors.
muc.loi_ro: For people in business, reputation is your strength: your name helps open doors.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Look after your brand's credibility: keep your promises, deliver on time.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: You earn through your own expertise and suit licensed independent professions.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Alongside your main work, take on teaching or writing about your field — it brings in clients and keeps your skills sharp.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: You tend to study and gain qualifications far away, then come back near home to work.
muc.viec_nen_lam: While studying away, stay in touch with workplaces back home so you have somewhere to return to.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: Your good name comes late: the quiet work you do today becomes known later on.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Keep a systematic record of your work and what you produce.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: When you have to choose between two big things at once, like exams and a wedding, you can get torn and finish neither.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Choose one to do first, and write down the start date for the other.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: Money comes, but with strings attached: profit on paper that's hard to collect, or income that easily causes disputes.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Only take work with a clear contract, and collect payment in stages.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: this period suits stepping up to be your own boss or starting your own venture.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Prepare a plan and capital in the first year of the period so you can use the favourable timing.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: A steady income from employment suits you; your way up is skill and experience.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Choose a workplace with a clear pay progression, and build your skills steadily every year.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: In the area with this trait, you tend to dwell on one thing and find it hard to let go even when you know you should.
muc.loi_ro: When it comes to {mang}, you tend to dwell on one thing and find it hard to let go even when you know you should.
muc.viec_nen_lam: When you notice yourself going round in circles, write down what's worrying you and set a day to decide.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: in this period many things don't go the way you want; you can easily get fed up and want to quit halfway.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Set a review point after a year instead of quitting while you're annoyed.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: in this period you may worry about the men close to you; caring early helps you feel more at ease.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Check in on your father and your partner more often in this period, especially about what they're worried about.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: Your mother worries about you a lot, sometimes to the point of pressure; the bond between you is still very close.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Tell your mother one small piece of good news each week to ease her worries.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: The two signs of happy events always mirror each other from opposite sides; where you see one, the other is there.
muc.viec_nen_lam: When checking a chart, confirm these two signs always sit in opposite areas.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: Your marriage is likely to be influenced by your parents: an introduction, or a nudge from them.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Listen to your parents, but spend enough time alone with the person to judge for yourself.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: One school of thought reads that children may come first or prompt the decision to marry.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Talk with the person about children and family plans early on.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: Friends are likely to push you towards the decision to marry, or the person comes from your own circle of friends.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Before a big decision, listen to friends but write down your own reasons.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: You decide your own marriage and rarely let anyone arrange it.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Since you decide yourself, also ask someone long married to see what you might be missing.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: You have an eye for people: you can easily see who will do well later, and can also easily be swept up by appearances.
muc.viec_nen_lam: When you like someone, write down three things beyond looks that you value in them.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: Your love life may have several chapters; later on, the person beside you may be quite a different age from you.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Be clear and respectful when closing a relationship, so the next chapter is lighter.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: There may be a period when happy events like a wedding easily get delayed or change plan.
muc.viec_nen_lam: If you plan to marry in this period, allow extra preparation time and a back-up date.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: a year likely to bring happy news in love or a wedding; many people feel more ready to take the next step.
muc.viec_nen_lam: If you're getting to know someone, use this year to talk seriously about a shared future.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: Your love life is likely to have very different phases; in the later phase, you usually choose someone who suits you better.
muc.viec_nen_lam: State clearly from the start what each of you expects of your roles at home.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: You're used to having your own space, even when in a couple; your partner needs to understand it isn't distance.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Agree on some time alone for each person every week.
muc.loi_nguoi_ay: They're used to having their own space, even when in a couple; it isn't distance, and the two of you should understand this about each other.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: Big decisions about a relationship usually last better when you have enough experience and the two of you have known each other long enough.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Let the relationship go through at least a year, hard times included, before marrying.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: Your partner is clever, sensitive and changes their mind often; an age gap sometimes helps the two of you balance each other.

muc.loi_nguoi_ay: Their chart sketches a clever, sensitive partner who changes their mind often; an age gap sometimes helps the two of you balance each other.
muc.viec_nguoi_ay: When plans change, ask each other why before reacting.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: You value mature, responsible people; a first love may not last, but once married it's usually lasting.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Don't rush to judge yourself by one break-up.
muc.loi_nguoi_ay: They value mature, responsible people; once committed, the relationship is usually lasting.
muc.viec_nguoi_ay: Don't rush to judge the relationship by one disagreement.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: In love you tend to fall fast and cool off fast too.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Wait until the initial infatuation has passed before big decisions.
muc.loi_nguoi_ay: Their romantic pace is fast and you may get swept up in each other at first; the two of you need time to learn what lasts.
muc.viec_nguoi_ay: Wait until the initial infatuation has passed before big decisions.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: A partner who suits you is usually gentle and sensible, and often comes from people you already know: classmates, colleagues, neighbours.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Pay attention to people you've known for a long time rather than only looking in new places.
muc.loi_nguoi_ay: Their chart sketches a gentle, sensible partner who often comes from people known for a long time: classmates, colleagues, neighbours.
muc.viec_nguoi_ay: Pay attention to the common ground the two of you have shared for a long time.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: This person is quite close to the partner your chart sketches; that helps the two of you understand each other from the start.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Even if they fit the picture, talk money and children through clearly before big decisions.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: You're both strong and both like to decide; you get on when you divide clearly who handles what.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Split decision areas: each person owns one area, and shared areas are discussed by both.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: One likes starting new things, the other likes keeping routines; these two rhythms balance each other if neither looks down on the other.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Each month choose one new thing to do together and one old habit to keep together.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: Two compatible charts may click more like close friends or siblings than like a couple; compatible doesn't mean becoming a couple.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Ask each other frankly what kind of relationship you each want.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: When both of you are in a favourable period, that's the time for big shared projects; when one is struggling, the other is the support.
muc.viec_nen_lam: Before a big shared step like buying a home, look at both people's ten-year periods.

muc.loi_doi_thuong: The old books link this trait with the eyes — the left with the sun, the right with the moon — so take preventive care; this reminder is not a substitute for a doctor.
